Successful HWPX template automation requires precise XML manipulation of section0.xml and removal of layout cache tags to ensure correct rendering.
The executor modified 'Contents/section0.xml' by joining fragmented text across '<hp:t>' elements and removing '<hp:lineSegArray>' tags to prevent stale layout display. Namespace mapping for 'hp', 'hh', and 'hpb' was maintained using ElementTree to preserve document integrity. Specific logic for severity notes and date reformatting (YYYY.MM.DD) was applied directly to the XML nodes, resulting in a 1.0 reward.
